title: Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards Servicing Thresholds: Courtesy Allowance, Restriction and Charge-Off
content:
Account-servicing thresholds of Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards, by card. Each column is the Marlowe & Finch card of that name.

| | Store Card | Store Card Plus | Store Card Elite | Mastercard | Platinum Mastercard | World Elite Mastercard |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Late fees reversible as a courtesy in any rolling 12 months | 1 | 1 | 2 | 1 | 1 | 2 |
| On-time statements before the late one, for a courtesy waiver | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 |
| Consecutive missed minimum payments that suspend charging | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 |
| Days past due at which a restricted account is charged off | 180 | 180 | 180 | 180 | 180 | 180 |

## Threshold definitions

- **Courtesy allowance** — the number of late fees that may be reversed as a courtesy in any rolling 12-month window.
- **On-time statements for a courtesy waiver** — the number of statements immediately before the late one whose minimum payment arrived on time, required for a courtesy waiver.
- **Missed payments that suspend charging** — the consecutive statements whose minimum payment was not received by the due date that cause charging privileges to be suspended.
- **Charge-off day count** — the days past due at which a restricted account is charged off.

## Reading the table (hypothetical)

A Marlowe & Finch Store Card Elite or World Elite Mastercard account can have up to 2 late fees reversed as a courtesy in any rolling 12 months; every other card, 1. On every card, 2 consecutive missed minimum payments suspend charging, and a restricted account is charged off at 180 days past due.
